About this mock

A static replica of Planning → Table with two chromes on the same synthetic data: Current (HEAD plus the uncommitted "N Story awaited" chip) and Proposed (the agreed redesign). The page opens on Proposed; flip with the switch (the scroll position is kept) or open #current.

What is real

  • CSS: frontend/dist/dashboard.css inlined verbatim (305 KB, sha1 ab5f58b11c43, file time 2026-10-02 08:16 UTC). Fonts load from Google Fonts like the app and fall back to serif / monospace offline.
  • DOM: captured 2026-10-02 09:52 UTC from the real React components (bundled from the working tree) running in the dashboard test harness: header, compact header, Filters bar, overview (compact and Show panel), Planned Teams Effort, the toolbar and its popups, and every table cell kind (status transitions, editors, chips, inputs). A self-check proves the mock's Current table markup equals the real DOM, row by row.
  • Data: synthetic only (PLAN-E…, "Alpha Team"…), shaped by rounded live aggregates. Profile: params.json. Regenerate: node tmp/planning-chrome-mock/generate.js.

What is simulated

  • Interactions are plain JS over the captured DOM: sorting (Proposed: asc, desc, off; Shift adds), Move left/right, Hide/Show, Rename, Show total, Archive, Add column (corner "+" appends, boundary "+" inserts), grip drag and drop, selection and the Accepted column, Save/Discard (no network), the overview following the selection, Show panel, touch mode.
  • Docked header and footer are fixed clones like the real app, but my own port of that logic. A position: sticky thead cannot dock inside the horizontal scroller, so the spec's "sticky thead" was not possible.
  • No scroll snap: the real app also jumps the page on the first scroll tick so the Filters stack lands under the compact header; the mock does not, so the first scroll looks different (the compact header and the toolbar relocation still happen on the first scroll).
  • Static, not functional: Filters popover and chips (the chips lane does collapse into "+n more"), Sort epics, Group by Initiative, Sprint/Group/Teams dropdowns, search, the Jira field editors (status, priority, SP, assignee, team, capacity, track), Back to top.
  • The Accepted column and its footer sum are the table-native replacement for the ACCEPTED bucket of Planned Teams Effort. Current has no Accepted column and keeps the panel as is.

New CSS (Proposed only, in the mock's own style block, sections A and B)

.segmented-control-compact, .fb-trigger-primary, the chevron lane and hover/touch rules for .planning-review-colmenu and .planning-review-drag, .planning-review-boundary*, .planning-review-corner, .mock-strip (P-B), .mock-teams-detail (P-C), plus the coherence overrides (slate literals to tokens, neutral ink). Each rule names the stylesheet it would move into.

URL presets

Comma separated, e.g. index.html#proposed,h2,pb,demo: current / proposed, h1 / h2, pa / pb / pc, touch, stories, demo (show the Effort and Risk notes demo columns), bar0 (controls collapsed), hidebar (no controls, for screenshots).
